rules: Standalone signals: no case, entity or map-line links. Incident date kept apart from report date; a body found is dated when found and the unknown time of death is stated. Suburb- and area-level points say 'approx.' and the location note starts 'APPROXIMATE MAP POINT'; estimated points say 'map point estimated' and 'ESTIMATED MAP POINT'. signals.title: Esangweni taxi rank, Tembisa (approx.): taxi driver shot dead and two wounded by gunmen; no arrests, 27 Oct
signals.content: A taxi driver was shot dead and two other people were wounded at the Esangweni taxi rank in Tembisa at about 05:00 on Tuesday 27 October, according to police. Police say five unknown men approached the victim, two of them armed with 9mm firearms, and opened fire; the two wounded were taken to hospital and the men fled on foot. The motive is unknown and no arrests had been made. No one is named. Tembisa South police station. One source, the SAPS Gauteng statement of 27 October; the only news coverage found was in Caxton papers, which are not used. The map point is approximate: the mapped Esangweni taxi rank, not a confirmed spot.

Tembisa South police precinct.

signals.title: Kloof Gold Mine hostel, Westonaria (map point estimated): two arrested, three AK-47s and an R5 rifle seized from illegal miners, 28 Oct
signals.content: Police, the army and the mine's own security moved on a group of armed illegal miners at the Kloof Gold Mine hostel in Westonaria on Wednesday 28 October, according to police. Sibanye Protection Services received information about the group at about 16:00 and asked the police Public Order Policing unit and the SANDF for help. Two men aged 32 and 35 were found with an AK-47 and an R5 rifle, and two more AK-47s were found abandoned. Police recovered three AK-47 rifles, one R5 rifle, six magazines, 246 live rounds and two Lesotho passports. The two men, Lesotho nationals, face charges of possessing unlicensed firearms and ammunition and were due in the Westonaria Magistrate's Court on 30 October. No one was killed or injured in the report. An arrest is not a conviction, and the accused are not named. Filed as Priority Intelligence (armed illegal mining), not as a crime pin. One source, the SAPS Gauteng statement of 29 October. The map point is estimated: the hostel is not mapped, so the pin is the Kloof mine area point.

checked.incident: Wed 28 Oct 2026; Sibanye Protection Services received information at about 16:00 (police). The time of the operation and arrests is not given. Court appearance expected Fri 30 Oct.
checked.location: ESTIMATED MAP POINT. Kloof Gold Mine Hostel, Westonaria (police). The hostel is not mapped. The pin is the 'Kloof' place point (OpenStreetMap, from the national place-names list) in the Kloof mine area east of Westonaria, used as a reference; the mine's shafts are spread over about 10 km. Westonaria police precinct. Uncertainty about 6 km. Not the hostel.
